_note: Made-up shops (no real business) in the shape talk() takes as `shop` (web/talk/server.mjs, notes/talking-personas.md, "Business mascots"): bolt.one's loader fills id, name, section, story, special, status, statusNote, menu [{name, price, appPrice, available}] and mascot {name, voice} from its database (appPrice: about what delivery apps charge for it; nulls count as not given); the rest is optional. The tests and smoke.mjs --shop=<id> use them.

cafe.name: Kettle and Kulhad
cafe.area: a quiet lane behind the bus stop
cafe.story: Meera opened Kettle and Kulhad in 2019 with one kettle, a borrowed table and her grandmother's masala recipe. The cardamom is still crushed by hand every morning. Office regulars come for the four o'clock chai break, and the back wall is covered in notes they have left over the years.
cafe.special: Kulhad masala chai with a warm bun maska, 60 rupees
offers: Saath walkers get 10 percent off any chai before 11 am

realestate.statusNote: the agent is in until 7 pm
realestate.area: the site office at the project gate
realestate.hours: 10 am to 7 pm; site visits with the agent
realestate.story: Banyan Grove is three towers built around a hundred-year-old banyan tree that the builder, Tulsi Developers, chose to keep. Work began in 2024. Tower A is ready to move into; the builder's plan has Towers B and C finishing in 2027.
realestate.special: The sample flat in Tower A is open for walk-in visits today
offers: A free covered parking slot with bookings made this month (the builder's offer; the agent has the terms)
